decisions.why: Heard-about-but-not-seen and wondering-about are explicitly rumor-consistent per canonical definition; no visit or content asserted.
Curiosity/tension and belief that gate 'might lead somewhere interesting' are speculative wondering, not confirmed knowledge of contents; consistent with hearsay-level awareness.
Memory of hearing someone mention the gate is itself hearsay, not observed interior detail or confirmed content, so it does not upgrade rumor to knowledge.
